regions.merged_text: Febr.22nd. My Dear Friends: God bless you one and all. Just a word to meet you down there as friend from up north. I hope it may please the Lord to bring you back in better weather and brighter hopes than saw you start on the trip I'd like to have made with you. Permit me to follow in spirit! At the same time, seeing your rather undue concern at dropping prices, etc, I thought a word of observation might help a little to steady someone's nerves. First of all, however, we should re-remember at all events, that success or want of the same is not essential as pertains temporalities. Sooner or later we shall have to drop them - if they don't drop us first. Why, therefore, lose our peace on their account? Then again, God often permits us to make temporal blunders in order to foster humility in our souls so that in the sight of Heaven we may be more amible. Finally this is "Presidential Election year." That means more or less a depression in farm prices at least till after Election-day. Business men will not invest till Election.
